site.sitedescription: Very small unnamed tarn dammed by a moraine in a cirque on the eastern side of Adamsons Peak in the Hartz Mountains. Surrounding vegetation: Astelia-Gleichenia bog and Cyperaceae sedgeland cover much of the cirque floor; nearby upland supports sclerophyll open-heath Nothofagus cunninghamii low closed-forest; krummholz Nothofagus cunninghamii and Eucalyptus coccifera occur above 1040 m.
